quote: the 41-year-old Itaipu… having an installed capacity of 14 gigawatts, and it’s currently going through a major technological update, executed by the CMI Consortium, formed by GE Vernova (leader), CIE SA, and Tecnoedil SA… expected to be completed over 14 years… Critical systems such as the Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Network Automation Technologies, for example, are planned for 2026.
note: Opened GE Vernova Itaipu modernization feature 20 Nov 2025.
